# Forced-colors selection repair

Cause: History/Scenario selection used only border and background colors, replaced by the browser forced palette. Original four actual-publisher browser cases fail when pointer and keyboard focus leave the selected button.

Repair: underline the already-selected History/Scenario label only inside forced-colors: active. Existing aria-pressed remains the state source; native button role and focus outline remain. No forced-color-adjust opt-out, new palette, markup, controller or data contract.

Dark treatment: ordinary graphite instruments unchanged. Under dark forced palette, the selected label keeps a system-colored underline; native focus remains a separate outline.
Light treatment: ordinary paper/hairline presentation unchanged. Under light forced palette, the same underline carries selection in the user palette. No equivalence claim for ordinary light/dark material from palette substitution.

Reference: existing History/Scenario controls, with recorded before-source styles and captures. Unavailability, language and context behavior remain existing-owned. Browser emulation is not OS high-contrast activation or screen-reader speech.

Evidence: four permanent bilingual dark/light forced-color tests, two narrow widths, both selection states using native Space/Enter and focus removal. Eight canonical forced-palette captures at1440/390; tabs are only shown in mobile layout, so desktop captures cover unchanged context. Original full-page source fixture and26asset inputs retained.

Independent review remains pending under original SUPPORT_PUBLICATION_REFUSED; no new worker or alternate reviewer. All release, rights, Saved and IW2 boundaries remain.
